Info

Concrete implementation of waypoint selection index state and bounds clamping.

class scarajectory.core.service.trajectory.plan.selection.plan_selection_state.PlanSelectionState(initial_index: int = -1)[source]¶

Bases: object

Concrete implementation of waypoint selection index state and bounds clamping.

It defines:

attributes:
_selected_index - Index of currently selected waypoint.
methods:
__init__ - Initializes selection state.
selected_index - Returns currently selected waypoint index.
set_selected_index - Sets selection index if within valid bounds.
clamp_to_count - Clamps selection to valid range for given count.
set_index_direct - Sets selection index directly without validation.
_selected_index: int¶
clamp_to_count(total_count: int) → None[source]¶

Clamps selection to valid range for given count.

Parameters:

total_count – Total count of waypoints.

Exceptions:

None.

property selected_index: int¶

Returns currently selected waypoint index.

Returns:

Selected waypoint index or -1.

Exceptions:

None.

set_index_direct(index: int) → None[source]¶

Sets selection index directly without validation.

Parameters:

index – Target index.

Exceptions:

None.

set_selected_index(index: int, total_count: int) → bool[source]¶

Sets selection index if within valid bounds.

Parameters:

  • index – Target index (-1 to total_count - 1).

  • total_count – Total count of waypoints.

Returns:

True if index is within valid bounds, False otherwise.

Exceptions:

None.
